kbmi.note: KBMI 1 = core capital below Rp6tn (POJK 12/POJK.03/2021). validation_ack.reason: Rounding, not a share-count error: FY2020 basic EPS is printed as a whole Rp5 (AR2020 FS PDF p. 309), while 44,868 / 8,193,072,560 weighted shares (AR2021 FS note, PDF p. 453) = Rp5.48. Year-end shares equal the weighted shares (no issuance in 2020 after the July 2020 pre-listing par change), so the 8.7% gap is entirely the rounding of a small EPS.

Real: FY2022 basic EPS Rp(20) uses weighted-average 13,545,283,972 shares (AR2022 FS note, PDF p. 494: (264,913) / 13,545,283,972 = (19.56)). shares_out is the registrar year-end count 14,655,617,601 (AR2022 PDF p. 131), which includes the 504,264,065 rights shares issued in June 2022 for the full year and the 850,000,000 PMTHMETD shares issued to PT BNC Technologies Ventures on 29 Dec 2022, which the FS keep out of share capital (booked as capital deposit funds pending OJK approval, FS Note 20).

Real: FY2023 basic EPS Rp(16) uses weighted-average 13,813,658,645 FS shares (AR2023 FS note, PDF p. 503: (226,738) / 13,813,658,645 = (16.41)), which exclude the 850,000,000 listed PMTHMETD shares still booked as capital deposit funds pending OJK approval (AR2023 FS Note 22). shares_out = registrar count 14,768,390,017 incl. those shares (AR2023 PDF p. 134).

Real: FY2025 basic EPS Rp11 uses weighted-average 13,918,499,438 FS shares (AR2025 FS Note 33d, PDF p. 818: 150,709 / 13,918,499,438 = 10.83), which exclude the 850,000,000 PMTHMETD shares listed on IDX since 30 Dec 2022 but still booked as capital deposit funds awaiting OJK approval (FS Note 20, PDF p. 795-796). shares_out = registrar/listed count 14,768,500,131 (AR2025 PDF p. 151), the count the AR uses for market capitalisation (p. 23). 150,709 / 14,768,500,131 = Rp10.2 would round to 10.

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document is the bank's own file on https://aladinbank.id/uploads/... (WordPress), fetched directly with curl and a browser User-Agent; no bot protection on the PDF paths (the /hubungan-investor URL and the WP REST API are blocked/restricted, not needed). The IR pages (/laporan-tahunan/, /laporan-triwulan/, /rapat-umum-pemegang-saham/, /prospektus/, /keterbukaan-informasi/) link only AR2023-AR2025; the AR2019-AR2022 file URLs were found in the Internet Archive CDX index of aladinbank.id/uploads/ and are still live on the bank's server (downloaded from there, not from the archive). FS pages that are scanned images (AR2025 PDF pp. 718, 720; AR2020 PDF pp. 307, 309; AGM summaries 2025/2026; the 31 Dec 2025 published report) were read from rendered page images.

ENTITY / NAME HISTORY: founded 1994 as PT Bank Maybank Nusa International -> PT Bank Maybank Indocorp (2000) -> PT Bank Maybank Syariah Indonesia (2010, sharia commercial bank, in run-off by 2019) -> acquired by PT NTI Global Indonesia (70%) and PT Berkah Anugerah Abadi (30%) on 31 Jan 2020 -> renamed PT Bank Net Indonesia Syariah (6 Jul 2020) -> IPO 1 Feb 2021 as 'BANK' -> renamed PT Bank Aladin Syariah Tbk in 2021 (AR2020 PDF p. 13; AR2021 FS header 'dahulu PT Bank Net Indonesia Syariah Tbk'). Controlling shareholder PT Aladin Global Ventures (formerly PT NTI Global Indonesia): 54.54% of FS shares / 51.40% of listed shares at end-2025. The bank has no subsidiaries or associates, so its stand-alone audited FS are the complete reporting entity; money figures are tagged 'consolidated' for that reason and all ratios (computed by the bank under OJK rules) 'bank_only' - there is no other basis. AR2022 is the June-2023 file AR-ALADIN-22-1.pdf; an earlier May-2023 upload (Annual-Report-2022.pdf, 496 pp.) exists with the same figures.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-2026 (complete list checked against the AR2025 listing chronology PDF pp. 155-157 and AR2021-AR2025 'Aksi Korporasi' sections): (1) IPO 1 Feb 2021: 5,000,000,000 new shares at Rp103 (OJK effective 22 Jan 2021) with 2,800,000,000 free Series I warrants (exercise Rp110, 2 Aug 2021 - 30 Jan 2026). (2) RIGHTS ISSUE PMHMETD I, ex-date 18 May 2022, 100,000 : 12,505 at Rp2,000, 504,264,065 shares taken up - the ONLY rights issue; the one record in corporate_actions. (3) PMTHMETD (private placement, no pre-emptive rights) 29 Dec 2022: 850,000,000 new shares at Rp1,400 to PT BNC Technologies Ventures (Rp1,190bn), listed 30 Dec 2022 - not a split/rights/bonus, so not in corporate_actions. (4) Series I warrant exercises 2021-Jan 2026: 221,164,006 by end-2025 (AR2025 p. 157) plus 171,230,954 in Jan 2026 before expiry (14,768,500,131 -> 14,939,731,085 voting shares at the 12 May 2026 record date). (5) Capital injections by AGV without new shares, booked as 'dana setoran modal': Rp170bn (28 Dec 2022), Rp152.5bn (2023), Rp123bn (2024). No split, reverse split or bonus issue after listing; no stock dividend (AR2024 p. 22, AR2025 p. 24). The brief's 'several rights issues 2021-2023' could not be confirmed: the 14 Oct 2021 summary prospectus (https://aladinbank.id/uploads/2022/03/Prospektus-Ringkas-PMHMETD-I-Aladin-Bank-14-Oktober-2021.pdf; provisional recording date 7 Dec 2021, price not yet set) was the same PMHMETD I, executed only in May-June 2022.

PRE-LISTING PAR-VALUE CHANGES (July 2020, NOT recorded as corporate actions): circular shareholder resolutions of 6 Jul 2020 (Deed No. 26) changed the par value from Rp866,928.50 to Rp200 (945,069 -> 4,096,536,280 shares, plus a Rp5,433.50 capital top-up) and of 14 Jul 2020 (Deed No. 53) from Rp200 to Rp100 (-> 8,193,072,560 shares) (AR2020 PDF pp. 180-183; FS2020 face PDF p. 307 shows 945,069 shares of Rp866,928.50 at end-2019). These are share subdivisions of an unlisted company with no exchange ex-date, no price history before 1 Feb 2021 and no stored per-share value on the old basis (FY2019 holds only balance-sheet levels; FY2019 EPS Rp69,259 is not stored). A reviewer may decide otherwise; adding them would change nothing on the page.

SHARE COUNT - TWO NUMBERS: the audited FS show 'modal ditempatkan dan disetor penuh' of 13,918,499,863 shares (end-2025) because the 850,000,000 PMTHMETD shares, although notarised (Deed No. 32, 17 Jan 2023) and listed since 30 Dec 2022, are kept in 'dana setoran modal' until OJK approves the capital increase (still pending in the 31 Mar 2026 FS and the 30 Sep 2026 report). The share registrar (BAE) tables in each AR, the AGM quorum counts and the AR market-cap figures use the listed count incl. those shares (14,768,500,131 end-2025). shares_out stores the listed/registrar count (what trades and what equity incl. the Rp1.19tn deposit belongs to); EPS is stored as printed (FS count), hence the eps_shares acks for 2022, 2023 and 2025. AR2023/AR2024 monthly share tables print 'Jumlah Saham Tercatat' about 146.6m below the registrar tables for 2023-2024 (e.g. 14,621,940,688 vs 14,768,496,865 at Dec 2024); the AR2025 table jumps to 14,768,498,265 in Jan 2025. Treated as a table error; registrar figures used.

SHARIA DEFINITIONS: loans_gross = gross financing = murabahah receivables (net of deferred margin, before allowance) + funds of qardh + musyarakah financing, matching the 3Q25 deck 'Financing' and the AR2025 'Pembiayaan' total. deposits = DPK = wadiah deposits + temporary syirkah funds (mudharabah giro/tabungan/deposito); for 2024-2025 the AR's DPK figure (which, like the OJK published report, excludes mudharabah funds placed by banks: Rp1,065m / Rp342m) is used - the FDR denominators. Temporary syirkah funds are not liabilities or equity on the FS face. nim = Net Imbalan (NI); npl_* = NPF; lar = PKR (only from the 2026 report template); car = KPMM.

LOSS YEARS AND OUT-OF-RANGE VALUES ARE REAL: net losses FY2021 Rp121.3bn, FY2022 Rp264.9bn, FY2023 Rp226.7bn, FY2024 Rp73.7bn (negative EPS/ROE/ROA as reported); FY2020 profit Rp44.9bn was largely a one-off reversal of contingency provisions; FY2025 profit Rp150.7bn. Validator range warnings are genuine: FDR 0.13% (2020) and 0.00% (2021, no financing at all while the bank relaunched as a digital bank), FDR 173.27% (2022, financing restarted faster than deposits), CAR 329-390% (2020-2021) and 96-189% (2022-2023) after the IPO/rights/private placement, CIR 186-411% and BOPO 355-428% in 2021-2023, ROA -10.85% (2022). Do not 'fix' them.

DIVIDENDS: none. The AGMs for FY2020 (29 Jul 2021: profit retained against the accumulated deficit), FY2021, FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 (19 Jun 2025) and FY2025 (4 Jun 2026) all resolved not to pay a dividend (payout_ratio v 0 each year with the AGM source); no interim dividend was ever declared. The bank still carries an accumulated deficit from sharia activities (Rp744.2bn end-2025; Rp667.4bn at 30 Sep 2026).

PRICES: year_end_price = December close in each AR's share table (2,290 / 1,415 / 1,240 / 825 / 950 for 2021-2025). FY2020 is null (not yet listed). No split after listing, so share_basis = period end everywhere. The rights issue's exercise price (Rp2,000) was above the market price at the ex-date, so any rights factor a price vendor applies to May 2022 should be ~1; the PMTHMETD private placement and warrant exercises are not price adjustments. BANK traded far above its Rp103 IPO price in 2021 (high Rp3,980 Aug 2021); IDX suspended the stock 16 Mar - 5 Apr 2021 for an unusual price rise (AR2021 p. 20).

RESTATEMENTS / DISCREPANCIES: no restatement of FY2019-FY2025 figures found (each FS comparative equals the prior year's audited number; AR highlight tables agree). Minor inconsistencies noted, not used: AR2025 segment table p. 21 gives 2023 financing 3,056,199 (net) vs FS gross 3,102,309; AR2024 reclassifies 2023 'estimated losses on commitments' out of other liabilities (total liabilities unchanged); FY2025 KPMM 49.29% (AR + FS Note 38) vs 49.38% in the 2025 governance report; AR2025 p. 24 calls the cumulative 221,164,006 warrant shares the '2025' conversions (the registrar tables show only +3,266 shares in 2025: 14,768,496,865 -> 14,768,500,131; p. 24 itself says 14,768,498,865 at 1 Jan 2025); 1 Jan 2024 registrar count 14,768,420,517 vs 31 Dec 2023 14,768,390,017.

INTERIM: 9M2026 from the single-page OJK published report of 30 Sep 2026 (unaudited, signed 26 Oct 2026); prior-year loans/deposits from the 30 Sep 2025 report. No full interim FS with notes or 3Q2026 analyst deck is on the IR site as of 3 Nov 2026. 9M2026 profit Rp47.3bn (-63% YoY) with NPF gross up to 0.84% and PKR 6.66%; CAR 38.43%. shares_out = 14,939,731,085 listed shares (AGMS 4 Jun 2026 quorum count, record date 12 May 2026), after warrant expiry; consistent with paid-up capital Rp1,408,973m + the 850m PMTHMETD shares.

NULLS: coc, npl_coverage and casa are not disclosed by BANK in any FY source (AR ratio tables, MD&A, year-end OJK reports, 3Q25 deck); lar is null for FY2020-FY2025 because PKR appears only in the 2026 report template. year_end_price FY2020 null (not listed). Nothing was computed from components.
